question: Which beings are said to serve this revered teaching or reality?
premises: The object is served by many classes of beings
These include gods, dānavas, gandharvas, siddhas, and cāraṇas
Such service indicates its high status
inference: This revered reality is served by gods, dānavas, gandharvas, siddhas, and cāraṇas
plain_english: It is served by gods, dānavas, gandharvas, siddhas, and cāraṇas.
